items.text: NY Jets (final): Geno Smith (ankle) full Friday, no designation, Glenn calls him the 'undisputed starter'. OUT - WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/hip), WR Isaiah Williams (ribs), DL David Onyemata (abdomen). QUESTIONABLE - G Dylan Parham (knee), DE Joseph Ossai (foot/ankle), DL Harrison Phillips (ankle), LB Trevin Wallace (groin); Parham, Ossai, Wallace full Fri. IR - OT Max Mitchell, DT T'Vondre Sweat, WR Arian Smith.

LA Chargers (final): OUT - LB Daiyan Henley (knee), CB Rodney Shelley (ankle), S Kendall Williamson (calf). DOUBTFUL - WR Brenen Thompson (hamstring). QUESTIONABLE - WR Ladd McConkey (back), TE Charlie Kolar (concussion), OT Trey Pipkins (knee), CB Tarheeb Still (ankle), CB Isas Waxter (ankle). IR - S Derwin James Jr., OT Rashawn Slater. Justin Herbert starts.
